messages.content: Tu es un oracle de laboratoire. Avant toute exécution des méthodes, prédis quelle stratégie sera la plus fiable pour chaque problème fourni. Ne résous pas les problèmes et ne prétends pas exécuter des méthodes. Retourne uniquement un objet JSON {"predictions":[{"problemId":"p1","probabilities":{"strategyName":0.3,...},"rationale":"..."}]} avec les trois noms exacts, chaque probabilité entre0et1 et somme exactement1. En cas de méthodes aussi fiables, exprime cette incertitude. Données: {"strategies":["exhaustive","structured","falsification"],"problems":[{"id":"p1","family":"arithmetique","type":"prime","n":221},{"id":"p2","family":"graphes","type":"shortestPath","nodes":["A","B","C","D","E","F"],"edges":[["A","B",4],["A","C",2],["B","D",5],["C","D",1],["C","E",7],["D","F",3],["E","F",1]],"directed":true,"start":"A","end":"F"},{"id":"p3","family":"optimisation","type":"knapsack","capacity":10,"items":[{"weight":6,"value":14},{"weight":5,"value":11},{"weight":5,"value":11}],"kind":"0/1"},{"id":"p4","family":"probabilites","type":"montyHall","doors":3,"hostKnows":true,"hostAlwaysOpensGoat":true,"hostAlwaysOffersSwitch":true},{"id":"p5","family":"logique","type":"entailment","premises":["all A are B","all B are C"],"conclusion":"all A are C"},{"id":"p6","family":"debugConceptuel","type":"lostUpdate","initial":0,"trace":["r1=x","r2=x","x=r1+1","x=r2+1"]},{"id":"p7","family":"combinatoire","type":"factorialZeros","n":100},{"id":"p8","family":"optimisation","type":"minCoins","target":63,"coins":[1,5,11,17]},{"id":"p9","family":"logique","type":"divisibility","min":51,"max":100,"divisibleBy":[4,6],"notDivisibleBy":5},{"id":"p10","family":"probabilites","type":"twoDice","sum":7,"sides":6}]}

predictions.rationale: Le problème est de déterminer si 221 est un nombre premier. L'approche exhaustive est la plus sûre car elle vérifie tous les diviseurs potentiels. La stratégie structurée pourrait utiliser des propriétés des nombres premiers pour éliminer rapidement des possibilités. La falsification pourrait être moins fiable car elle dépend de la capacité à générer des fausses affirmations.
